create_XP_experiment: create an XP experiment object with a DoraConfig, parameters, and argument list
use_XP_enter_context: use the XP enter context manager to temporarily activate an experiment context
get_XP_current: get the current active XP experiment object from within an XP context
check_is_xp: check if the code is currently running within an active XP experiment context
compute_XP_signature: compute a SHA1 signature from a list of experiment parameter delta tuples
